( 54K . XTE INK4 Firmware )

|00 @System/vector $2 &pad $6 &r $2 &g $2 &b $2
|10 @Console/vector $2 &read $1 &pad $5 &write $1
|20 @Screen/vector $2 &width $2 &height $2 &auto $1 &pad $1 &x $2 &y $2 &addr $2 &pixel $1 &sprite $1
|80 @Controller/vector $2 &button $1 &key $1
|90 @Mouse/vector $2 &x $2 &y $2 &state $1 &pad $3 &scrollx $2 &scrolly $2
|a0 @File/vector $2 &success $1 &success-lb $1 &stat $2 &delete $1 &append $1 &name $2 &length $2 &read $2 &write $2
|b0 @File2/vector $2 &success $1 &success-lb $1 &stat $2 &delete $1 &append $1 &name $2 &length $2 &read $2 &write $2
|d0 @Battery/percent $1 &usb $1 &mv $2
|2000 @path/memlen
|0040 @decstr/buflen
|0100 @recent/buflen
|0040 @bookmark/buflen
|0020 @directory/buflen
|0011 @directory/lines
|0011 @txt/lines
|01e0 @window/width
|0320 @window/height
|00f0 @window/center
|0190 @window/middle
|01c0 @window/right

|000

	@path/buf $1 &buf+1 $7f &cap
	@txt-token/buf $60 &cap
	@directory/sel $1
	@txt/file $2
	@bookmark/page $2
	@pen/x $2

|100

%Screen/<set-pos> ( x* y* -- ) {
	.Screen/y DEO2
	.Screen/x DEO2 }

@on-reset ( -> )
	#e0f0 .System/r DEO2
	#e0f0 .System/g DEO2
	#e0f0 .System/b DEO2
	;window/width .Screen/width DEO2
	;window/height .Screen/height DEO2
	path/<init>
	directory/<bind>
	BRK

%Screen/<clear> ( -- ) {
	#0000 DUP2 Screen/<set-pos>
	[ LIT2 80 -Screen/pixel ] DEO }

(
@|Path )

@path/<init> ( -- )
	.&buf LDZ ?{ ;dict/home-path !/<set> }
	;&buf str/cap ,&ptr STR
	POP JMP2r

@path/get-location ( -- str* )
	[ LIT2 02 _&ptr ] LDR EQU ?{
		[ LIT2 00 _&ptr ] LDR #01 SUB
		&>w
			#01 SUB LDZk LIT "/ EQU ?{ !/>w }
		INC JMP2r }
	;dict/home JMP2r

@path/<set> ( path* -- )
	[ LIT2 -&buf _&ptr ] STR
	( >> )

@path/<push-str> ( subpath* -- )
	&>wpu
		LDAk DUP ?{ POP POP2 JMP2r }
		/<push>
		INC2 !/>wpu

@path/<push> ( c -- )
	[ LIT2 00 &ptr -&buf ]
	( | clamp )
	.&cap LTHk ?{
		( | TODO: Warn overflow )
		SWP }
	POP
	( ) INCk ,&ptr STR
	STZ2
	JMP2r

@path/<pop> ( -- )
	;&buf ;dict/home-path str/cmp ?{
		,&ptr LDR /up INC #00 OVR STZ
		,&ptr STR }
	JMP2r

@path/up ( ptr -- addr )
	#01 SUB .&buf SWP
	&>rup
		#01 SUB LDZk [ LIT "/ ] EQU ?{ NEQk ?/>rup }
	NIP JMP2r

@path/<reload> ( -- )
	;&buf .File/name DEO2
	;&memlen .File/length DEO2
	;&mem .File/read DEO2
	directory/<reset>
	/<nullws>
	/<parse-folders> !/<parse-files>

@path/<parse-folders> ( -- )
	;&mem
	&>wfo
		LDAk DUP ?{ POP POP2 JMP2r }
		LIT "- NEQ ?{ directory/push }
		#0005 ADD2 str/cap INC2 !/>wfo

@path/<parse-files> ( -- )
	;&mem
	&>wfi
		LDAk DUP ?{ POP POP2 JMP2r }
		LIT "- EQU ?{ directory/push }
		#0005 ADD2 str/cap INC2 !/>wfi

@path/<nullws> ( -- )
	;&mem
	&>wnw
		LDAk DUP ?{ POP POP2 JMP2r }
		#1f GTH ?{ LITr 00 STH2k STAr }
		INC2 !/>wnw

@path/is-home ( -- t )
	.&buf+1 LDZ2 LIT2 "/ 00 EQU2 JMP2r

(
@|Directory )

@directory/<bind> ( -- )
	;&on-button .Controller/vector DEO2
	path/<reload>
	path/is-home ?{ !/<redraw> }
	( | recall )
	recent/<load>
	;recent/buf LDAk ?{ POP2 !/<redraw> }
	/<push> !/<redraw>

@directory/on-button ( -> )
	.Controller/button DEI
	( | handlers )
	DUP #10 NEQ ?{ /<sel-prev> }
	DUP #20 NEQ ?{ /<sel-next> }
	DUP #01 NEQ ?{ /<enter> }
	DUP #02 NEQ ?{ /<leave> }
	DUP #08 NEQ ?{ /<sleep> }
	POP BRK

@directory/<sleep> ( -- )
	wallpaper/<draw>
	#800f DEO
	JMP2r

@directory/<sel-prev> ( -- )
	.&sel LDZ
	( clamp ) DUP ?{ POP /get-length }
	#01 SUB !/<set-sel>

@directory/<sel-next> ( -- )
	.&sel LDZ
	( clamp ) INCk /get-length LTH ?{ POP #ff }
	INC !/<set-sel>

@directory/<sel-first> ( -- )
	#00 !/<set-sel>

@directory/<set-sel> ( id -- )
	.&sel STZ !/<redraw>

@directory/<enter> ( -- )
	/get-length ?{ JMP2r }
	[ LIT2 00 -&sel ] LDZ DUP ADD ;&buf ADD2 LDA2 file/is-folder ?{
		( | Not folder )
		file/is-icn ?icn/<bind>
		file/is-txt ?txt/<bind>
		POP2 JMP2r }
	( | Is folder )
	path/<push-str>
	path/<reload> !/<sel-first>

@directory/<leave> ( -- )
	path/<pop>
	path/<reload> !/<sel-first>

@directory/get-length ( -- length )
	/get-bounds SUB2 #01 SFT2 NIP JMP2r

@directory/get-bounds ( -- to* from* )
	,&ptr LDR2 ;&buf JMP2r

@directory/<reset> ( -- )
	;&buf ,&ptr STR2
	#0000 ;&buf STA2
	JMP2r

@directory/push ( desc-name* -- desc-name* )
	DUP2 #0005 ADD2
	( | visible )
	file/is-supported ?{ POP2 JMP2r }
	( >> )

@directory/<push> ( name* -- )
	[ LIT2 &ptr =&buf ]
	( | clamp )
	;&bufend LTH2k ?{
		( TODO: Warn ) SWP2 }
	POP2
	( | save )
	INC2k INC2 ,&ptr STR2
	STA2
	JMP2r

@directory/<redraw> ( -- )
	wallpaper/<draw>
	#00 decstr/make-battery path/get-location header/<draw>
	( >> )

@directory/<draw-files> ( -- )
	#0018 #0040 Screen/<set-pos>
	/get-bounds SUB2k ORA ?{
		POP2 POP2
		( | Empty folder )
		;dict/empty !uf5/<draw-str> }
	[ LIT2r -&lines 00 ]
	&>l
		GTH2k ?{ &end POP2r POP2 POP2 !/<draw-selector> }
		EQUkr STHr ?/end
		( | Draw )
		LDA2k file/<draw>
		#20 uf5/<draw-glyph>
		( | Check if fits on line )
		#0018 .Screen/x DEO2
		.Screen/y DEI2k #0028 ADD2 ROT DEO2
		INC2 INC2 INCr !/>l

@directory/<draw-selector> ( -- )
	[ LIT2 45 -Screen/auto ] DEO
	#0000 [ LIT2 00 -&sel ] LDZ #0028 MUL2 #0040 ADD2 Screen/<set-pos>
	;arrow-icn .Screen/addr DEO2
	[ LIT2 05 -Screen/sprite ] DEOk DEO
	JMP2r

(
@|File )

@file/is-supported ( name* -- name* t )
	LDAk LIT ". EQU ?/fail
	/is-folder ?{
		/is-icn ?{
			/is-txt ?{ &fail #00 JMP2r } } }
	#01 JMP2r

@file/is-folder ( name* -- name* t )
	DUP2 str/cap #0001 SUB2 LDA LIT "/ EQU JMP2r

@file/is-icn ( name* -- name* t )
	DUP2 str/cap #0004 SUB2 ;dict/icn-ext !str/cmp

@file/is-txt ( name* -- name* t )
	DUP2 str/cap #0004 SUB2 ;dict/txt-ext !str/cmp

@file/exists ( path* -- t )
	.File2/name DEO2
	#0001 .File2/length DEO2
	;&e .File2/stat DEO2
	[ LIT &e $1 ]
	( not folder ) DUP LIT "- NEQ
	( not missing ) SWP LIT "! NEQ AND JMP2r

@file/<draw> ( name* id* -- )
	#05 !uf5/<draw-trim-color>

(
@|Icn )

@icn/on-button ( -> )
	.Controller/button DEI
	( | handlers )
	DUP #08 NEQ ?{ directory/<sleep> }
	?{ BRK }
	directory/<bind>
	BRK

@icn/<bind> ( path* -- )
	;&on-button .Controller/vector DEO2
	( >> )

@icn/<display> ( path* -- )
	decstr/make-path
	( >> )

@icn/<draw> ( path* -- )
	Screen/<clear>
	DUP2 /read-size /center STH
	STH
	[ LIT2 05 -Screen/auto ] DEO
	.File/name DEO2
	.Screen/x DEI2 ,&anchor STR2
	#00 STHr DUP2 #30 SFT2 .File/length DEO2
	( c ) SUB
	( r ) #00 STHr SUB
	( y ) [ LITr -Screen/y ] DEI2r
	&>row
		;&buf DUP2 .File/read DEO2
		.Screen/addr DEO2
		( | Draw col )
		OVR [ LIT2r 05 -Screen/sprite ]
		&>col
			DEOkr
			INC DUP ?/>col
		POP POP2r
		( | next row )
		[ LIT2 &anchor $2 ] [ LIT2r 0008 ] ADD2r STH2kr Screen/<set-pos>
		INC DUP ?/>row
	POP2 POP2r JMP2r

@icn/center ( w h -- w h )
	DUP #01 SFT #00 SWP #30 SFT2 ;window/middle SWP2 SUB2 .Screen/y DEO2
	OVR #01 SFT #00 SWP #30 SFT2 ;window/center SWP2 SUB2 .Screen/x DEO2
	JMP2r

@icn/read-size ( str* -- w h )
	str/cap #0009 SUB2
	( no size ) INC2k INC2 LDA [ LIT "x ] EQU ?{ POP2 #1010 JMP2r }
	LDA2k /read-byte STH
	#0003 ADD2 LDA2 /read-byte STHr SWP JMP2r

@icn/read-byte ( a b -- byte )
	chr/hex SWP chr/hex #40 SFT ORA JMP2r

(
@|Txt )

%pen/<pen-glyph> ( c -- ) {
	#20 SUB #00 SWP ;uf5/widths ADD2 LDA #00 SWP .pen/x LDZ2 ADD2 .pen/x STZ2 }

@txt/<bind> ( path* -- )
	;&on-button .Controller/vector DEO2
	DUP2 bookmark/<set-path>
	DUP2 .&file STZ2
	decstr/make-path DUP2 recent/<save>
	.File/name DEO2
	#0001 .File/length DEO2
	bookmark/<load>
	txt-token/<reset>
	bookmark/get /goto-page !/<draw-page>

@txt/on-button ( -> )
	.Controller/button DEI
	( | handlers )
	DUP #01 NEQ ?{ bookmark/<pin> }
	DUP #02 NEQ ?{ directory/<bind> }
	DUP #40 NEQ ?{ /<first-page> }
	DUP #10 NEQ ?{ /<prev-page> }
	DUP #20 NEQ ?{ /<next-page> }
	DUP #08 NEQ ?{ directory/<sleep> }
	POP BRK

@txt/<prev-page> ( -- )
	bookmark/get ORA ?{ JMP2r }
	txt-token/<reset>
	bookmark/<dec>
	( | scan )
	.&file LDZ2 decstr/make-path .File/name DEO2
	#0001 .File/length DEO2
	( | scan )
	bookmark/get /goto-page !/<draw-page>

@txt/goto-page ( id* -- )
	#0000 EQU2k ?{
		&>ws
			/<pen-page>
			INC2 GTH2k ?/>ws }
	POP2 POP2 JMP2r

@txt/<pen-page> ( -- )
	( | draw a token )
	#0018 .pen/x STZ2
	[ LIT2 -&lines 00 ] txt-token/<pen>
	&>s2
		txt-token/read ?{ !/end }
		( | wrap )
		txt-token/get-width .pen/x LDZ2 ADD2 ;window/right LTH2 ?{ /<pen-lb> }
		NEQk ?{ POP2 JMP2r }
		( | not empty )
		txt-token/<pen>
		( | linebreak )
		!/>s2

@txt/<first-page> ( -- )
	txt-token/<reset>
	#0000 bookmark/<set>
	.&file LDZ2 decstr/make-path .File/name DEO2
	#0001 .File/length DEO2 !/<draw-page>

@txt/<next-page> ( -- )
	( | Clear )
	bookmark/<inc>
	bookmark/<save>
	( >> )

@txt/<draw-page> ( -- )
	Screen/<clear>
	#0018 #0048 Screen/<set-pos>
	[ LIT2 -&lines 00 ] txt-token/<draw>
	&>s
		txt-token/read ?{
			txt-token/<draw>
			/<draw-lb>
			#7f uf5/<draw-glyph> !/end }
		( | wrap )
		txt-token/get-width .Screen/x DEI2 ADD2 ;window/right LTH2 ?{ /<draw-lb> }
		NEQk ?{ &end POP2 #01 decstr/make-bookmark .&file LDZ2 !header/<draw> }
		( | not empty )
		txt-token/<draw>
		( | linebreak )
		!/>s

@txt/<draw-lb> ( line -- line )
	INC .Screen/y DEI2k #0028 ADD2 ROT DEO2
	#0018 .Screen/x DEO2
	JMP2r

@txt/<pen-lb> ( line -- line )
	INC #0018 .pen/x STZ2
	JMP2r

(
@|Token )

@txt-token/<reset> ( -- )
	[ LIT2 -&buf _&ptr ] STR
	[ LIT2 00 -&buf ] STZ
	JMP2r

@txt-token/read ( -- cap )
	/<reset>
	&>s
		;&c .File/read DEO2
		.File/success-lb DEI ?{ #00 JMP2r }
		[ LIT &c $1 ]
		( | handlers )
		DUP #09 NEQ ?{ POP #20 }
		DUP [ LIT2 00 &ptr -&buf ] INCk ,&ptr STR
		STZ2
		DUP #20 GTH ?{ JMP2r }
		POP !/>s

@txt-token/utf8-walk ( ztr -- ztr )
	&>utf8
		INC LDZk #06 SFT #02 EQU ?/>utf8
	JMP2r

@txt-token/<draw> ( line -- line )
	[ LIT2 45 -Screen/auto ] DEO
	.&buf
	&>w
		LDZk DUP ?{ POP2 JMP2r }
		DUP #0a NEQ ?{
			POP SWP txt/<draw-lb>
			SWP !/cg }
		uf5/<draw-glyph> &cg /utf8-walk !/>w

@txt-token/<pen> ( line -- line )
	.&buf
	&>wp
		LDZk DUP ?{ POP2 JMP2r }
		DUP #0a NEQ ?{
			POP SWP txt/<pen-lb>
			SWP !/cp }
		pen/<pen-glyph> &cp /utf8-walk !/>wp

@txt-token/get-width ( -- width* )
	.&buf LIT2r 0000
	&>wgw
		LDZk DUP ?{ POP2 STH2r JMP2r }
		#20 SUB #00 SWP ;uf5/widths ADD2 LDA LITr 00 STH
		ADD2r /utf8-walk !/>wgw

@header/<draw> ( bookmark left* right* -- )
	( | Left )
	#0018 DUP2 Screen/<set-pos>
	uf2/<draw-trim>
	( | Spacer )
	#0018 #0038 Screen/<set-pos>
	[ LIT2 01 -Screen/auto ] DEO
	#ca01 ;dotted-line [ LIT2 05 -Screen/sprite ] <draw-times>
	( | Right )
	#01c8 #0018 Screen/<set-pos>
	uf2/<draw-right>
	( | Bookmark )
	?bookmark/<draw>
	JMP2r

@wallpaper/<draw> ( -- )
	;dict/wallpaper-path DUP2 file/exists ?icn/<draw>
	POP2 Screen/<clear>
	JMP2r

(
@|Bookmark )

@bookmark/<inc> ( -- )
	.&page LDZ2 INC2
	( >> )

@bookmark/<set> ( page* -- )
	.&page STZ2
	JMP2r

@bookmark/<dec> ( -- )
	.&page LDZ2 #0001 SUB2 !/<set>

@bookmark/<load> ( -- )
	;&buf file/exists ?{ JMP2r }
	;&buf .File2/name DEO2
	#0002 .File2/length DEO2
	;&page .File2/read DEO2
	JMP2r

@bookmark/<save> ( -- )
	;&buf .File2/name DEO2
	#0002 .File2/length DEO2
	;&page .File2/write DEO2
	JMP2r

@bookmark/<set-path> ( path* -- )
	/<reset>
	/<push-str>
	;dict/bookmark-ext
	( >> )

@bookmark/<push-str> ( str* -- )
	( >> ) &>w
		LDAk DUP ?{ POP POP2 JMP2r }
		/<push>
		INC2 !/>w

@bookmark/<push> ( c -- )
	#00 [ LIT2 &ptr =&buf ] INC2k ,&ptr STR2
	STA2
	JMP2r

@bookmark/<reset> ( -- )
	;&buf ,&ptr STR2
	#0000 ;&buf STA2
	JMP2r

@bookmark/get ( -- page* )
	.&page LDZ2 JMP2r

@bookmark/<pin> ( -- )
	/<save>
	( >> )

@bookmark/<draw> ( -- )
	;&buf file/exists ?{ JMP2r }
	;&buf .File2/name DEO2
	#0002 .File2/length DEO2
	;&current .File2/read DEO2
	.&page LDZ2 LIT2 &current $2 EQU2 ?{ JMP2r }
	#01b8 #0000 Screen/<set-pos>
	;&sprite-icn .Screen/addr DEO2
	[ LIT2 01 -Screen/sprite ] DEOk DEO
	JMP2r

(
@|Recent )

@recent/<save> ( buf* -- )
	;&filepath .File2/name DEO2
	DUP2 str/len .File2/length DEO2
	.File2/write DEO2
	JMP2r

@recent/<load> ( -- )
	;&filepath .File2/name DEO2
	;&buflen .File2/length DEO2
	;&buf .File2/read DEO2
	JMP2r

	&filepath "recent.boo 00

(
@|DecStr )

@decstr/<reset> ( -- )
	;&buf ,&ptr STR2
	#0000 ;&buf STA2
	JMP2r

@decstr/<push-str> ( num* -- )
	&>w
		LDAk DUP ?{ POP POP2 JMP2r }
		/<push>
		INC2 !/>w

@decstr/<push-num> ( short* -- )
	[ LIT2r ff00 ]
	&>read
		#000a DIV2k STH2k MUL2 SUB2 STH2r INCr ORAk ?/>read
	POP2
	&>write
		NIP #30 ADD /<push>
		OVRr ADDr STHkr ?/>write
	POP2r JMP2r

@decstr/<push> ( c -- )
	#00 [ LIT2 &ptr =&buf ]
	( | clamp )
	;&bufend LTH2k ?{
		( TODO: Warn ) SWP2 }
	POP2
	( | save )
	INC2k ,&ptr STR2
	STA2
	JMP2r

@decstr/make-path ( str* -- buf* )
	;&buf SWP2 /<reset>
	;path/buf /<push-str> !/<push-str>

@decstr/make-battery ( -- buf* )
	;&buf /<reset>
	[ LIT2 00 -Battery/percent ] DEI /<push-num>
	LIT "% !/<push>

@decstr/make-bookmark ( -- buf* )
	;&buf /<reset>
	bookmark/get INC2 !/<push-num>

%utf8/cont ( addr* -- addr* cont ) {
	LDAk #06 SFT #02 EQU }

@utf8/next ( addr* -- addr* )
	INC2 /cont ?/next
	JMP2r

(
@|Uf2 )

@uf2/get-width ( text* -- width* )
	LIT2r 0000
	&>wg
		LDAk DUP ?{ POP POP2 STH2r JMP2r }
		#0000 ROT #20 SUB ;&widths ADD2 LDA STH2
		ADD2r INC2 !/>wg

@uf2/<draw-right> ( text* -- )
	DUP2 /get-width STH2
	.Screen/x DEI2k STH2r SUB2 ROT DEO2
	( >> )

@uf2/<draw-str> ( text* -- )
	[ LIT2 15 -Screen/auto ] DEO
	&>w
		LDAk DUP ?{ POP POP2 JMP2r }
		/<draw-glyph>
		INC2 !/>w

@uf2/<draw-trim> ( text* -- )
	[ LIT2 15 -Screen/auto ] DEO
	&>wdt
		LDAk
		( | handlers )
		DUP LIT ". NEQ ?{
			POP
			( icn ) DUP2 ;dict/icn-ext str/cmp ?/end
			( txt ) DUP2 ;dict/txt-ext str/cmp ?/end
			LIT ". }
		DUP LIT "_ NEQ ?{ POP #20 }
		/<draw-glyph>
		INC2 LDAk ?/>wdt &end POP2 JMP2r

@uf2/<draw-glyph> ( c -- )
	#20 SUB #00 SWP
	( addr ) DUP2 #50 SFT2 ;&glyphs ADD2 .Screen/addr DEO2
	;&widths ADD2 LDA #00 SWP .Screen/x DEI2 ADD2
	( draw ) [ LIT2 &color 01 -Screen/sprite ] DEOk DEO
	.Screen/x DEO2
	JMP2r

(
@|Uf5 )

@uf5/<draw-str> ( text* -- )
	[ LIT2 45 -Screen/auto ] DEO
	&>w
		LDAk DUP ?{ POP POP2 JMP2r }
		/<draw-glyph>
		utf8/next !/>w

@uf5/<draw-trim-color> ( text* color -- )
	,&color STR
	( >> )

@uf5/<draw-trim> ( text* -- )
	[ LIT2 45 -Screen/auto ] DEO
	&>wdt
		LDAk
		( | handlers )
		DUP ?{ POP &end POP2 JMP2r }
		DUP LIT ". NEQ ?{
			POP
			( icn ) DUP2 ;dict/icn-ext str/cmp ?/end
			( txt ) DUP2 ;dict/txt-ext str/cmp ?/end
			LIT ". }
		DUP LIT "_ NEQ ?{ POP #20 }
		/<draw-glyph>
		.Screen/x DEI2 #01a0 LTH2 ?{
			POP2 LIT2 ".. /<draw-glyph> !/<draw-glyph> }
		utf8/next !/>wdt

@uf5/<draw-glyph> ( c -- )
	#20 SUB DUP #60 LTH ?{ POP #1f }
	#00 SWP
	( addr ) DUP2 #00a0 MUL2 ;&glyphs ADD2 .Screen/addr DEO2
	;&widths ADD2 LDA #00 SWP .Screen/x DEI2 ADD2
	( draw ) [ LIT2 &color 05 -Screen/sprite ] DEOk DEOk DEOk DEO
	.Screen/x DEO2
	JMP2r

(
@|Stdlib )

@<draw-times> ( -cols auto addr* action* -- )
	STH2
	.Screen/addr DEO2
	.Screen/auto DEO
	&>t
		DEOkr
		INC DUP ?/>t
	POP POP2r JMP2r

@chr/hex ( char -- <val> )
	( dec ) [ LIT "0 ] SUB DUP #09 GTH [ JMP JMP2r ]
	( hex ) #27 SUB DUP #0a SUB #05 GTH [ JMP JMP2r ]
	( nil ) POP #ff JMP2r

@str/cmp ( a* b* -- f )
	STH2
	&>wc
		LDAk ?{ &d LDA LDAr STHr EQU JMP2r }
		LDAk LDAkr STHr NEQ ?/d
		INC2 INC2r !/>wc

@str/cap ( str* -- end* )
	LDAk ?{ JMP2r }
